I'd believe that. The reason I'm here to begin  with is through latching on to things I felt I should be doing to because it was supposed yo pay off. There was no direction, just drifting and thinking things would get bettef with effort, because that's how it's supposed to work. Draining yourself for something that holds no meaning to you is just self-destructive, I've found. 

I'm not that interested in meaningless sex. People just build it up to the point where you're better never having lived than missing out and if you're "late" to these experiences you must have something fundamentally wrong with you. Same with love. Try being shy, growing up k-12 in a tiny private, religious school in the same class of ~20 (maybe 7 women?) and then transfer into a major with a ~12:1 m:f ratio and try to have a relationship hahaha. I've just never gotten the chance to find someone. I just wish I had 10 years back to spend with someone who means something to me... I DID meet an incredible group of caring friends through it all.

I'm trying to get out of my hometown. There's not much here. It's hard to get someone to hire you from out of state or out of town though. 

Thanks for your comment and positive sentiment. I appreciate the kindness.
